gemini-omni-1.1-flash.description: Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash conversational video generation, editing, and extension
gemini-omni-1.1-flash.pricingNotes: Gemini pricing bills Omni video output at $17.50 per 1M tokens, counted at 5,792 tokens per second of 720p video, about $0.10/s. 360p, 1080p, and 4K use the same published 720p effective rate until Google publishes resolution-specific token rates. 1080p and 4K are documented as upscaled. Input tokens ($1.50 per 1M) and thinking/text output ($9 per 1M) are extra and not modeled. Unspecified duration is budgeted at 10 seconds. Discounts, regional differences, taxes, and provider credits are ignored unless provider usage is returned.

grok-imagine-video-1.5.description: Grok Imagine Video 1.5 text, image, and reference video generation model
grok-imagine-video-1.5.pricingTier: xAI public Imagine API video pricing
grok-imagine-video-1.5.pricingNotes: Grok Imagine Video 1.5 output costs $0.08/s at 480p, $0.14/s at 720p, and $0.25/s at 1080p. Each input image costs $0.01. Reference-to-video is capped at 720p. Discounts, regional differences, enterprise pricing, taxes, and provider credits are ignored unless provider usage is returned.

ltx-2-5-fast.description: LTX-2.5 Fast text/image video generation and first-to-last-frame interpolation
ltx-2-5-fast.pricingNotes: Text/image/interpolation pricing per output second at 720p/1080p/1440p/4K. CLI sends 24 fps and fixed duration (default 8s). No extend, retake or reframe. Discounts, enterprise pricing, taxes and credits excluded. Latency inherited from 2.3 and provisional.

ltx-2-5-pro.description: LTX-2.5 Pro text/image video generation and first-to-last-frame interpolation
ltx-2-5-pro.pricingNotes: Text/image/interpolation pricing per output second at 720p/1080p/1440p/4K. CLI sends 24 fps and fixed duration (default 8s). No extend, retake or reframe. Discounts, enterprise pricing, taxes and credits excluded. Latency inherited from 2.3 and provisional.

alibaba/happyhorse-1.1.description: Alibaba Happy Horse 1.1 text, image, and reference-to-video model
alibaba/happyhorse-1.1.pricingNotes: Replicate Happy Horse 1.1 estimates use published per-second output pricing. The CLI sends an explicit 720p default resolution for provider-default selection.

alibaba/wan-3.description: Alibaba Wan 3.0 text-to-video and image-to-video model; 2–30s, 480p/720p/1080p
alibaba/wan-3.pricingNotes: Replicate Wan 3.0 estimates use published per-second output pricing ($0.05 at 480p, $0.10 at 720p, $0.20 at 1080p). The introductory discount is excluded under ADR-010.

pixverse/pixverse-v6.description: PixVerse V6 text, image, transition, multi-shot, and native-audio model
pixverse/pixverse-v6.pricingNotes: Published per-second prices vary by output resolution and native-audio selection.

bytedance/seedance-2.5.description: Seedance 2.5 native-audio video generation; 4–30s, 480p/720p, up to 30 images/10 videos/10 audios
bytedance/seedance-2.5.pricingTier: Official output-second billing by resolution and video-input presence
bytedance/seedance-2.5.pricingNotes: Host billingConfig verified September 11. Output seconds only; video references select a higher rate, not a separate input-duration charge. Audio does not change the rate. Intelligent duration is conservatively budgeted at 30 seconds.

ray-3.2.description: Luma Ray 3.2 text-to-video and image-to-video model
ray-3.2.pricingTier: Luma Agents pay-as-you-go video generation pricing
ray-3.2.pricingNotes: Ray 3.2 standard dynamic range video generation is priced per clip by resolution and duration: 360p $0.06/$0.18, 540p $0.15/$0.45, 720p $0.30/$0.90, 1080p $1.20/$3.60 for 5s/10s. HDR, EXR, edit, and reframe tiers are not modeled here. Provisioned Throughput discounts, taxes, and provider credits are ignored.

minimax/h3.description: MiniMax H3 multimodal video generation with native audio
minimax/h3.pricingNotes: fal.ai lists MiniMax H3 at $0.26 per generated second.

bytedance/seedance-2.5/text-to-video.pricingNotes: Published approximate output-second equivalents at 16:9. Token rate is $0.0214/1000 at 480p/720p, $0.0234/1000 at 1080p; reference videos apply 0.6 to the token rate and bill input plus output duration. Unknown input duration is budgeted at the 30.2s host limit. Audio on/off has the same price.
